decisions: Pilot uses 300/50 Ry for parent and fragment calculations alike (difference below the predefined 0.03 eV/A fidelity target).
DFT jobs run serially (concurrency gave no throughput).
C32H66 is limited to a separately budgeted size-transfer check; C64/C128 isolated boxes are infeasible on this machine.
description: Real CP2K 2026.2 timing/convergence probe (2026-11-06/07) on this machine (11 cores, 5 performance; 36 GB). All-trans chains built by a quick probe script (not the demo generator; geometry not relaxed, max force ~3.5 eV/A). PBE-D3, DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH/GTH-PBE, isolated WAVELET cubic box (padding as in GMD_active's CP2K adapter), EPS_SCF 1e-6, OT/DIIS, local scheduler.

runs.note: stopped after 3 steps: no faster than 5 OpenMP threads (~17 s/step)
ran concurrently with the C32 probe; wall time inflated by memory-bandwidth contention
stopped after 5 SCF steps; extrapolated ~45 steps -> ~2.7 h wall (~13.5 core-h) per full label
